from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            agent_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.AGENT_LOCAL_RULES_DEBATE,
                prompt_custom.AGENT_ZERO_EDGE_DEBATE,
                prompt_custom.AGENT_COUNTING_DEBATE,
                prompt_custom.AGENT_SUBSET_DEBATE,
                prompt_custom.AGENT_SKEPTICAL_VERIFIER_DEBATE,
            ],
            moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.MODERATOR_CONSENSUS_MINES,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.SEQ_RECHECK_FORCED_MINES, prompt_custom.SEQ_FINAL_FORMAT_ONLY])
        final = await seq(f"Problem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft answer:\n{draft['response']}")
        return final["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
